instrumentation_note: Full frame, native, extract, render and present boundaries are retained. C/D additionally collect CPU, readback, staging and cell preparation diagnostics. Copy submission and draw command acquisition are inside upload/record/full callback timings; public submit_ms measures the final draw submission only. Cell comparison work is inside the callback but outside the upload timer. Timings are never subtracted or summed across independently aggregated medians. Older missing fields are unavailable. A/B were measured earlier in the stated order; the separate R19 old/split/old short controls use identical shipping PSX module bytes and normal unattached execution. Acceptance considers complete first and rotation frames, including any shifted Present wait.
interpretation: Rejected for promotion: correct queued-data handling and shorter command-record time did not establish stable complete-frame improvement. In the same-module old/split/old controls, the city wait shifted into Present. In this full comparison, forest warm median is 15.621 ms with PSX versus 7.663 ms with old arms on the same new Host; multi-level warm is 14.640 versus 10.557 ms. At viewport 1768x1084, none of the ten PSX scene first-frame medians is below 15 ms; 231 of 640 individual first frames are at most 15 ms. A/B are retained earlier controls, and differences between separate native runs do not isolate GPU execution or prove a unique root cause. Both new 80-record runs and all unfavorable samples are preserved. No static arm geometry retransmission or quality reduction was introduced. The prior source3e9 remains the main PR candidate, with its separate ordinary-rotation performance limitation still open.
candidate_preparation_description: Original native draw; four-stream hashing, retained staging, exact cell reuse and separately submitted required frame copies
